title: Canonical pullback on structure sheaf cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{ab}}$ and $\mathcal O_{Y,\mathrm{ab}}$ be their structure sheaves regarded as sheaves of abelian groups. For $n\geq0$, their cohomology is the Zariski sheaf cohomology [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Define $f^*:H^n(Y,\mathcal O_Y)\to H^n(X,\mathcal O_X)$ by first applying the exact inverse-image functor $f^{-1}$ to an Ext class from the constant integer sheaf, precomposing with the canonical comparison $\mathbb Z_X\simeq f^{-1}\mathbb Z_Y$, and then applying cohomology to the morphism $f^{-1}\mathcal O_{Y,\mathrm{ab}}\to\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{ab}}$ adjoint to the structure-sheaf homomorphism $f^\#: \mathcal O_{Y,\mathrm{ab}}\to f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{ab}}$.
